evidencePolicy.allowed: Already-consumed, nonlocked R1-R5 development evidence plus a complete immutable R6 handoff after it is sealed.
evidencePolicy.missingRawPolicy: Retain manifest-level lineage and hashes, mark rawUnavailable=true, and do not infer image, pose, or diversity fields.
evidencePolicy.deduplication: Exact image SHA-256 duplicates are one visual observation. Repeated renders and frames in the same local pose neighborhood never create independent scientific groups.

spatialIndependence.componentRule: Connect records sharing ancestry, close starts, or bidirectional trajectory overlap. A group is independent only if it is disconnected under the primary rule; readiness must also report the conservative sensitivity result.

visualStructuralIndependence.intensityRepresentation: Clean ultrasound grayscale, bilinear resize to 128x128, values in [0,1].
visualStructuralIndependence.intensityThresholdSource: Three times the maximum nonlocked per-case q95 repeat-render RMS128 frozen by G2-R5 from already-consumed G2-R3-A2 controls.
visualStructuralIndependence.structuralRepresentation: Unsigned gradient-orientation histogram: 128x128 grayscale; centered finite-difference gradients; 4x4 spatial cells; 8 orientation bins over [0,pi); magnitude weighting; per-cell then global L2 normalization.
visualStructuralIndependence.structuralThresholdSource: Conservative absolute pre-outcome floor chosen before any R6 capture/outcome inspection. It is deliberately not optimized from candidate data. The audit also measures this descriptor on already-consumed nonlocked G2-R3-A2 same-pose repeats; if their q95 is >=0.0033333333333333335 (one third of the floor), structural novelty fails closed rather than relaxing the threshold.
visualStructuralIndependence.noveltyRule: Pixel RMS alone is never anatomical novelty. A representative is visually/structurally independent only when both its minimum RMS distance and its minimum gradient-orientation distance to every comparison representative are strictly above their frozen thresholds. Image-hash uniqueness is insufficient.
visualStructuralIndependence.groupDiversityRule: Every pair of representatives counted as distinct structural groups must pass both thresholds; otherwise merge the groups for readiness counts.

labels.inconsistent: Any disagreement between finalTargetAcceptable and the frozen score-floor relation blocks readiness until explained; it is never silently relabeled.

allRequired: label agrees with finalTargetAcceptable and the frozen score floor
decisionSupportEligibility.appliesTo: Every positive AND every negative observation or group counted toward basin, reachability, ENGINEERING_DEMO_DATA_READY, or SCIENTIFIC_TRAINING_DATA_READY.
decisionSupportEligibility.offT7Policy: Off-T7 observations remain in integrity and descriptive coverage summaries but cannot support any Phase 2 readiness or reachability verdict, even when they are evaluator-negative.

positiveControlReproducibility.rule: PASS only if every minimum-count control satisfies every restoration, safety, label, score-stability, image-hash, RMS, and structural-repeat condition. Borderline label flips fail reproducibility.

basinStability.rule: A basin is stable only when at least three adjacent sampled pose cells are acceptable, one interior pose has score>=floor+0.005 and passes the positive-control repeat rule, and a safe executed sequence reaches that interior pose. Finite search establishes a sampled basin, not a global optimum.

targetIndependentReachability.success: At least one route from a marker-derived start conservative-spatially independent of all positive controls enters a repeat-stable acceptable basin using only the predeclared target-independent action program.
targetIndependentReachability.failureAccounting: Report separately never observed target, observed but not revisited, reached but not fresh-confirmed, unsafe, and integrity failure.

allRequired: integrity PASS and source/scene/evaluator/floor identities match the frozen contract
at least one repeat-stable acceptable basin
at least one target-independent safe route succeeds from a conservative-spatially independent marker-derived start
at least 24 positive and 48 negative unique-pose decision observations after exact-hash deduplication
positive observations span at least 2 provenance/spatial groups and negatives span at least 3, including at least 1 hard-negative group
every counted positive and negative observation satisfies decisionSupportEligibility, including T7-validity
ENGINEERING_DEMO_DATA_READY.interpretation: Supports the fixed-anatomy engineering demo and a later bounded training proposal; it is not scientific dataset adequacy.

allRequired: at least 6 independent positive groups and at least 6 independent negative groups under provenance, primary spatial, and dual RMS-plus-structural merging
the conservative spatial sensitivity retains at least 6 positive and 6 negative groups
each label has at least 3 train groups, 1 calibration group, and 2 heldout-development groups with no ancestry, spatial, repeat, hash, or structural overlap across roles
at least 3 structurally distinct representative clusters per label after the dual-distance rule
no readiness count depends on missing raw evidence or renderer repeats
SCIENTIFIC_TRAINING_DATA_READY.interpretation: Permits a later explicitly approved bounded training experiment. It does not authorize training or a locked/confirmation evaluation.

verdictInterface.failClosed: Unknown, missing, partial, mutable, hash-mismatched, label-inconsistent, or budget-exceeding evidence cannot satisfy a gate and must appear in blockingReasons.
